name: BP Appointments - HHC Community Advisory Boards (CAB)
description: This dataset lists members of community advisory boards (CABs) associated with the Health and Hospitals Corporation, including each member's board, last and first name, whether they serve as a representative or appointee, their term of office, the effective and expiration dates of that term, and whether they hold voting status. With 90 rows and eight columns, it provides a roster-level view of board composition and appointment terms. It could be used to track board membership and turnover, identify current versus expiring terms, compare voting and non-voting members, or analyze representation across different advisory boards.
